name: ReachStream Email Verifier
description: ReachStream Email Verifier checks email addresses in real time using SMTP-level validation, so your messages reach real inboxes instead of bounce folders. Verify a single address or a full list before you send.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ReachStream Email Verifier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ReachStream Email Verifier to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://emailverifier-mcp.reachstream.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ReachStream Email Verifier MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ReachStream Email Verifier provides these MCP tools: create_email_verification_request, get_email_verification_request, and get_multiple_email_verification_requests.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ReachStream Email Verifier?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ReachStream Email Verifier in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does ReachStream Email Verifier MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ReachStream Email Verifier requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ReachStream Email Verifier is developed by ReachStream. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
